summary: taskWorker.taskPollerType is never initialized during setup, but pollerBalancer expects it to be set to either Sticky or Not Sticky. This causes incorrect task balancing behavior.
userImpact: Task distribution may be incorrect because pollerBalancer cannot properly balance task workers without knowing their poller types.
rootCause: newScalableTaskPoller does not set scalableTaskPoller.taskPollerType during workflow poller initialization
proposedFix: Wire workflow poller types through for mixed/non-sticky/sticky workflow pollers in newScalableTaskPoller and newWorkflowTaskWorkerInternal
keyQuote: taskWorker.taskPollerType is never set. Should be set to either Sticky or Not Sticky.
